an4.156:1.1: “Monks, there are these four uncountables of an eon.
an4.156:1.3: “When an eon is devolving, it’s not easy to count as
an4.156:1.4: ‘so many years’ or ‘so many hundreds of years’ or ‘so many thousands of years’ or ‘so many hundreds of thousands of years.’
an4.156:2.1: “When an eon stays having devolved, it’s not easy to count as
an4.156:2.2: ‘so many years’ or ‘so many hundreds of years’ or ‘so many thousands of years’ or ‘so many hundreds of thousands of years.’
an4.156:3.1: “When an eon is evolving, it’s not easy to count as
an4.156:3.2: ‘so many years’ or ‘so many hundreds of years’ or ‘so many thousands of years’ or ‘so many hundreds of thousands of years.’
an4.156:4.1: “When an eon stays having evolved, it’s not easy to count as
an4.156:4.2: ‘so many years’ or ‘so many hundreds of years’ or ‘so many thousands of years’ or ‘so many hundreds of thousands of years.’
an4.156:4.3: “These, monks, are the four uncountables of an eon.”
